title: Talk blip steals an SFX voice blindly and cuts the quest/level/heart jingle that just started
repro: Music.blip() takes _sfx[_next_voice % 6] without checking .playing. The usual pattern is sfx('quest_done') (2.5 s jingle, lands on the first free voice, usually voice 0) then m.say([...]) -> Dialogue._next -> blip(). Every time the round-robin pointer sits on the jingle's voice the jingle is cut at ~0.1 s (project.gd:201-203, commons.gd:539-540/668-669, interior.gd:781-784, quests.gd:79 and ~20 more jingle-then-say sites). Same for levelup (2.7 s), j_heart, craft_done, j_battle_won. Probe tools/probe_c6_09_blip.gd (headless): quest_done then 6 dialogue lines -> the jingle's voice was taken by a blip in 12/12 trials.
fix: In blip(), pick a free voice first like sfx() does; if none is free, skip the blip (it is the least important sound) rather than stealing. Optionally give blips their own dedicated AudioStreamPlayer like _steps so they never compete with jingles. Also make sfx()'s steal path skip voices playing j_*/quest_done/levelup when another busy voice is available.

title: Per-speaker blip pitch is drowned out by the random take: speakers are not told apart
repro: talk_blip/_2/_3 are three different notes (~626, 790, 992 Hz: about 8 semitones apart) and _load_sfx picks one at random every line; blip() then pitches by name hash over 0.8-1.3 (also ~8 semitones). The same villager sounds a different note each line, two villagers overlap constantly, so the 'each speaker keeps their own pitch' promise (music.gd:440, AUDIO-PLAN line 19) does not hold. Probe: 30 'Maple' lines gave all three takes (talk_blip, _2, _3) at pitch 1.13, i.e. three different notes for one speaker.
fix: In blip() pick the take from the name hash too (takes[h % takes.size()]) instead of randi(), or always use the base take and let the pitch carry identity; narrow the pitch band to ~0.85-1.2 so extremes don't sound like chipmunks/boom. Add a small Music.blip_take(who) helper so tests can assert a speaker gets the same take+pitch twice.

title: Gangster-arc money sounds are ~5-6 dB louder than the crystal-arc coin (Money.SFX swap skips GROUP_DB)
repro: Music.sfx('coin') -> Money.sfx_name -> 'cash_pickup'. GROUP_DB has 'coin': -3 but no 'cash' key, so cash_pickup plays at 0 dB group; its takes are also hotter (loudest-100 ms RMS, after group+voice: coin -31/-28/-28 dB vs cash_pickup -22/-22/-28 dB). Every sell-box drop, Sal fence sale, permit, coin pickup is ~5-6 dB louder in the gangster arc. Same for 'cash' (shop buy, commons, rec: -23/-21/-30) and 'cash_register' (sleep payout, -23/-22/-28) vs coin. Also cash_pickup loses the 'jingles stay in key' pitch lock that coin has (music.gd:366 checks the name after the swap).
fix: Add GROUP_DB entries {'cash': -6.0} (prefix covers cash, cash_pickup, cash_register) tuned to match coin, or run Money.sfx_name AFTER computing group/pitch from the original name. Put 'cash_pickup' in the pitch-lock list. Re-check with a loudness table (probe script in /tmp/c6_09 style: loudest 100 ms RMS + group).

title: UI click family is uneven: 'tab', 'scroll_tick' and 'nope' are ~8 dB louder than ui_tap/menu_open
repro: Effective loudness (loudest 100 ms RMS incl. -4 voice + GROUP_DB): ui_tap -27, menu_open -27, menu_close -27, talk_blip -28, but tab -19 (no 'tab' group), scroll_tick -19 (no group), nope -19 (no group, plays on every refused action: 22+ call sites). Switching menu tabs clacks louder than every other menu tap; in Crystal Stack every left/right shift plays scroll_tick (arcade_stack.gd:253), so it rattles 8 dB over the menu clicks for the whole round; arcade picker/level select use it per move too.
fix: GROUP_DB += {'tab': -9.0, 'scroll_tick': -9.0, 'nope': -5.0} (or level the files with tools/sfx_soften.py --only tab,scroll_tick,nope --force). For Crystal Stack shifts consider a softer dedicated tick or ui_tap at -5.

title: New j_* jingles are 4-7 dB louder than quest_done/levelup; j_page/j_region jump out
repro: Effective loudness: quest_done -18.6, levelup -18.5, craft_done -19.2, j_confirm -18.6 but j_region -11.1, j_page -11.4 (2.8 s, for a journal page pickup, secrets.gd:254), j_treasure -13.0, j_gift -13.8, j_heart -14.7, j_victory -14.7, j_secret -15.0. GROUP_DB gives every j_ 0 dB, so picking up a journal page is ~7 dB louder than finishing a quest. j_buy (prize counter, prize_screen.gd:137) is -15.6, about 12 dB over the coin it stands beside.
fix: Per-name trims in GROUP_DB placed before the 'j_' prefix (dict order is checked first-match): 'j_page': -7, 'j_region': -7, 'j_treasure': -5, 'j_gift': -4.5, 'j_heart': -4, 'j_victory': -4, 'j_secret': -3.5; or normalise the files with sfx_soften.py. Keep quest_done/levelup as the reference. 'j_buy': -6.

title: Arcade points and ticket wins use 'coin', which becomes a banknote rustle in the gangster arc
repro: Money.SFX swaps every 'coin' to 'cash_pickup' (real Money_20/22/24 bills from the 202-more-sounds pack) when arc == gangsters. In-game arcade scoring isn't money: Block Jumper coin collect (block_jumper.gd:299), Whack gold grump (arcade_whack.gd:249), Gallery gold duck (arcade_gallery.gd:150), Skee 50+ pocket (arcade_skee.gd:285), and the bowling ticket payout (rec_center.gd:817 'coin' when not a new best) all play a cash rustle in the gangster Rec Hall instead of a retro arcade blip. Tickets are not cash either.
fix: Use a non-money cue for arcade scoring: e.g. a new name 'arcade_coin' (retro_coin_01 from 50-cc0-retro-synth-sfx is already in the CC0 pool, arcade_floor uses it) or 'sparkle'/'pop'; bowling ticket payout -> 'ticket' cue (see c6_09_07) or 'j_confirm'. Keep 'coin' only where real money moves (arcade_game.gd:262 fee is correct).
audio_needed: optional: arcade_coin (retro 8-bit coin, CC0 pack already on hand) and a ticket-stub cue

title: Arcade results play the 2.5 s war-defeat jingle (j_battle_lost) on ordinary ticket-winning rounds; Skee-Ball essentially always 'loses'
repro: ArcadeGame.game_over: won_tickets >= _good_tickets() ? j_victory : j_battle_lost. Skee-Ball keeps the default 15 but pays s/20 (+cups): gen_rec's own pacing sim scores casual/regular/keen at 90/100/120 = 4/5/6 tickets, so every Skee round, even an expert's, ends on the battle-lost jingle. Whack (default 15): casual 120 -> 10 tickets -> defeat. Gallery (20, pays s/25): regular 420 -> 16 -> defeat. Stack (12): casual 1500/8 lines -> 10 -> defeat. The player won tickets and hears the campaign-loss sting.
fix: Three tiers instead of two: new best or >= good -> j_victory; won_tickets > 0 -> a short neutral 'ticket' cue (j_confirm, or a ticket-stub printer cue, ~0.5 s); 0 tickets (or Block Jumper death) -> soft 'nope'/j_battle_lost at -6 dB. Retune per-game _good_tickets from gen_rec's sim (skee ~8, gallery ~16, whack ~14, stack ~10), ideally read from gen_rec PAYOUT 'soft' * 0.5 so it tracks the economy.
audio_needed: optional: a short ticket-stub/printer cue (CC0 or ACE kit)

title: Reading mail is silent: no paper sound per letter, gift taken / favour paid have no cue, letters 'speak' with a voice blip
repro: GameMap.read_mail() and farm._mailbox() open each letter through Dialogue with who 'Letter from X' / 'Letter': the only sound is Music.blip('Letter from Maple'), a talk voice whose pitch differs from Maple's own (different hash string). The 'mail' cue (paper_01/02) only plays on the 'You have N new letters' toast (game_map.gd:2748). Taking a mailed gift (Mail.act -> toast '+n item') and sending a favour ('Sent. +◆n', real money in) play nothing. 'No new mail.' also plays a blip-less silent box.
fix: In read_mail/_mailbox: Music.sfx('mail') as each letter opens (or 'page'); sfx('pickup') on gift taken, sfx('coin','pickup') on favour paid, 'nope' on Mail.act error. In Dialogue._next skip blip for non-speakers: who starting with 'Letter', 'Journal', 'Board', 'Community Board', 'Sell box' (or a line flag "silent": true) and play 'page' instead.

title: Notification cues are picked by sniffing toast words; new quests, birthdays and most notes are silent while ready-made cues sit unused
repro: GameMap._process plays a cue for run.notes only if the text contains 'letter' (mail) or 'level'/'heart'/starts with 'built' (levelup). Results: skill level-up toast -> levelup OK; a heart-perk note whose perk text says 'heart' plays levelup on top of the j_heart that change_friend already played (two jingles stacked); 'It's X's birthday today!' (game_state.gd:2796) silent though j_birthday was rendered for it (ace_kits jin_warm); 'New quest: ...' toasts (game_map.gd:889, farm.gd:1497) silent; overnight pay/traps silent. Rendered, never played: j_birthday, crop_ready, new_item, save_done, shop_bell (tools/ace_kits.py kit_bells), door_close.
fix: Give notify() an optional cue: GameState.notify(text, sfx := '') storing {text, sfx} (keep plain strings working), and play exactly that cue in GameMap._process, dropping the word sniffing. Wire: birthday -> j_birthday; New quest toasts -> new_item (or j_page at -7); morning 'N crops ripe' line -> crop_ready; Save & back to title / autosave-on-request -> save_done; shop counters (Shops.run first menu) -> shop_bell once per visit. Perk-note keep silent (j_heart already played).

title: A new heart from the daily chat plays two jingles at once (j_heart + levelup)
repro: Town talk: GameState.add_friend(id, 5) already plays sfx('j_heart') when a heart threshold is crossed (game_state.gd:1933, 'a new heart, from any source'); town._heart_unlock (town.gd:851-855, called at town.gd:815) then plays sfx('levelup') for the same heart. Different names, so the 70 ms de-dupe doesn't merge them: a 2.7 s levelup fanfare on top of the heart chime, and then the dialogue's blip may cut one of them (c6_09_01).
fix: Remove the sfx in town._heart_unlock (or drop the function); add_friend owns the heart jingle.

title: quest_done (2.5 s fanfare) also plays for rare fish, Mer joining, ops, crew, colony, project stages, so it stops meaning 'quest complete'
repro: 25+ sites call sfx('quest_done'). Non-quest ones: game_map.gd:4356 top-tier fish catch (repeats on every good catch while fishing), mine.gd:2357 Mer joins, ops.gd:80/156, racket.gd:173, crew.gd:136 recruit, colony.gd:249. Better cues already exist and are unused or rarely used: j_treasure, j_confirm, new_item, j_heart.
fix: Rare fish -> 'j_treasure' for the first of a species, else 'sparkle'; companion/crew joins -> 'j_heart'; ops/racket/colony steps -> 'j_confirm'. Keep quest_done for complete_quest paths only.

title: Menu sound gaps: full-screen UIs close silently, dialogue choice cursor is silent, locked buttons give no 'nope', hack keypress nearly inaudible
repro: GameMenu toggles play menu_open/menu_close, but CraftScreen.close (craft_screen.gd:103), ChestScreen.close (chest_screen.gd:142), PrizeScreen._close, CampaignScreen.close play nothing; CraftScreen opens silently too (Chest plays chest_open). Dialogue choice up/down (dialogue.gd:589-594) moves the focus with no tick while every arcade picker ticks. Skill 'Learn' when locked and other disabled _button rows: a disabled Button never emits pressed, so the tap is silent (no 'nope'). HackGame keypress: GROUP_DB -10 on a quiet file -> about -37 dB effective vs ui_tap -27, inaudible on a phone speaker. CraftScreen 'The bench fee is ◆n.' (craft_screen.gd:337) refuses with a toast and no 'nope'.
fix: menu_close in each full-screen close(), menu_open on CraftScreen open; a soft 'ui_tap' at -6 (or scroll_tick once levelled, c6_09_04) on choice focus moves; in GameMenu._button connect gui_input on disabled buttons to sfx('nope') at a low level; GROUP_DB keypress -10 -> -3. Add sfx('nope','thud') to the bench-fee refusal.

title: Turning 'All sound' back on restarts the current song from the top
repro: Music.toggle_mute(): muting calls _player.stop(); unmuting calls _player.play() which starts at 0 s. Mute/unmute during a long area song (or the ending track) restarts it; if the ending (ONCE) already finished, unmuting plays it again from the start instead of credits.
fix: Remember _player.get_playback_position() when muting and play(pos) on unmute; or skip stop() entirely since the Master bus mute already silences everything (just set stream_paused). Don't restart a finished ONCE track.

title: Buy/sell cues are inconsistent across counters and arcs; the crystal arc's shop buy plays a banknote/register sound
repro: Shop buy (shops.gd:168), community market (commons.gd:760/839), rec snack (rec_center.gd:980) play 'cash' in BOTH arcs. 'cash' is snd_purchase_0 + Money_01/05 from the 202-more-sounds Money set, i.e. bills/register, though the penguin arc pays in crystals; Money.SFX only swaps 'coin'. Permits (shops.gd:221) play 'coin', prize counter plays 'j_buy', the overnight payout plays coin or cash_register. Dropping items in the sell box (farm.gd:1456) plays the coin 'paid' sound though nothing is paid until night. Not enough money: toast + nope, fine. j_buy (the musical buy cue rendered for this) is used only at the prize counter.
fix: One buy cue per arc: Money.SFX-style map in both directions, e.g. crystal arc 'cash' -> 'j_buy' (or 'coin'), gangster arc 'coin'/'j_buy' -> 'cash_register' for purchases and 'cash_pickup' for income. Sell box drop -> 'drop'/'thud' (a box sound), keep the coin for the morning payout. Optional shop_bell when a counter menu opens.

title: Ticket gifts and arcade milestones are silent (welcome gift, Rec Cup win, milestone toasts)
repro: Tickets.add has no sound and its callers add none: Rec welcome gift (+20, rec_center.gd:630-631) is a toast only; Rec Cup win (rec_reno.gd:164-165) is a notify() with no keyword, so GameMap._process plays nothing for the season's top arcade prize; ArcadeHub.set_milestone (arcade_hub.gd:143-150) toasts 'Arcade milestone: ...' silently. Only bowling and game-over results make a sound.
fix: A shared Tickets.cue(n) -> sfx('ticket' or 'j_confirm') used by welcome gift and quest/perk ticket rewards; Rec Cup -> j_victory; milestones -> j_secret (or new_item). With c6_09_09's notify(text, sfx) these become one-line changes.

title: Nothing silences audio when the phone backgrounds the game (web build): music/ambience may keep playing behind other apps
repro: The web head_include listens to visibilitychange only to save (dreamsSaveNow); GameMap._notification on FOCUS_OUT/APPLICATION_PAUSED only saves. Music/Ambience have no focus or visibility handling, and Godot's web audio context isn't suspended by the engine on tab hide in every browser (Android Chrome keeps WebAudio running while the screen is on). Only the arcade games pause themselves on focus loss (and that pause plays menu_open). Needs a device check: switch to another app mid-song on Tom's phone.
fix: In Music (process ALWAYS) handle NOTIFICATION_APPLICATION_FOCUS_OUT / APPLICATION_PAUSED / WM_WINDOW_FOCUS_OUT: AudioServer.set_bus_mute(Master, true) (unless the user mute is on) and restore on FOCUS_IN/RESUMED; on web also hook visibilitychange via JavaScriptBridge to the same. Don't play menu_open for the automatic arcade focus-loss pause.
